add_definitions(-D_DXAPI_)
spec2def(dxapi.sys dxapi.spec)

# dxapi.sys is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dxapi-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(dxapi_shims OBJECT main.c)
target_link_libraries(dxapi_shims PRIVATE libntoskrnl libhal)
add_cargo_module(dxapi dxapi-cargo dxapi.sys
    KIND kernelmodedriver
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dxapi_shims psdk)
